bio: Hartley Coleridge was an English poet and essayist, the eldest son of Samuel Taylor Coleridge. He spent much of his life in the Lake District, writing sonnets and short lyrics.
Palgrave includes one of his lyrics, "She is not fair to outward view".

poems.title: She is not fair to outward view
poems.author: Hartley Coleridge
poems.collection: The Golden Treasury, ed. F. T. Palgrave (1861)
poems.text:
She is not fair to outward view
As many maidens be;
Her loveliness I never knew
Until she smiled on me.
O then I saw her eye was bright,
A well of love, a spring of light.

But now her looks are coy and cold,
To mine they ne'er reply,
And yet I cease not to behold
The love-light in her eye:
Her very frowns are fairer far
Than smiles of other maidens are.
